vehicles.cut_loop: Loop under hood — double-cut. Kills HV outside pack + airbags; powered seats still work. 2nd loop: behind rear right seat (2025+). Full de-power: loop cut + LV negative cut + wait 2 min.

vehicles.airbag_hv: Loop cut disables airbags. No engine noise ≠ off — silent movement possible.
vehicles.tow: Flatbed only — all wheels up. Rear motor generates power if wheels spin.
vehicles.release: 2025+ rule: 45 min clear — no fire, smoke, popping, hissing, heating — before release. Then 50 ft quarantine, TIC check, escorted tow.

generic_shutdown.title: Generic NEC 706.15 shutdown — confirm in ERG
steps: Labelled ESS disconnect / rapid-shutdown switch (NEC 706.15 — at system or service entrance): OFF.
Open battery / inverter AC breaker at panel.
Open any labelled DC isolator on the battery unit.
Lock out / tag out if possible.
Shutdown ≠ de-energized — cells hold stranded energy. Treat as live inside.

bess_chemistry.lfp_note: Later, less violent. Vent gas ~41% hydrogen — deflagration risk in closed spaces.
bess_chemistry.nmc_note: Earlier, faster, releases its own oxygen. Both vent HF + toxics. HF IDLH 30 ppm. 4-gas does NOT read HF / HCN.

hazmat_erg_147.title: Lithium Ion and Sodium Ion Batteries
fire_notes: Battery fire can reignite any time after knockdown — up to weeks later.
NO salt water — increases hydrogen + HF gas.
Reignition signs: white smoke off-gassing, arcs/sparks, flames.
hazmat_erg_147.honest_limit: Planning estimate only — Guide 147 lists NO green-page distances. Minimums, not maximums. Confirm: Hazmat + live monitoring + wind. Unsure of chemistry? Use the largest zone.

vent_notes.nmc_nca: cathode releases its own oxygen — faster, hotter, self-sustaining. Vent gas: HF + CO + H2. Rapid cell-to-cell spread.
vent_notes.lfp: slower, cooler — but vent gas ~41% hydrogen. Collects in closed spaces, lights off late. Vent gas: HF + CO.

zone_map.plume_note: NOT ERG Table 1 — Guide 147 has no green-page distances. Night applies the ERG green-table principle (stable air at night = larger downwind distance) as a planning value for the HF plume (Guide 125).
